units: Targ. Job XXI, 24 for עטיניו, a. meanings of Arab. ʿaṭana) [to moisten, cause dripping,] to pack olives in a vat preparatory to crushing.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:4">Men. VIII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 86a:23">86ᵃ</cite>) <he>הזית השלישי עוֹטְנוֹ בתוך הבית וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בבית</he>, Bab. ed. <he>בבית הבד</he>) the third crop of olives (which are hard) he packs in the house, until they begin to rot &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:4">Tosef. Toh. X, 4</cite> <he>העוֹטֵין זיתיו בין שני בדין</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:3">Toh. IX, 3</cite> <he>העוֹטֵן … בשני בתים</he>) if a man divides his olives and packs them in two separate pits (houses); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>עָטוּן</he>; pl. <he>עֲטוּנִים</he>, <cite ref="E00313"><he>עֲטוּנִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:5:2">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>דרך … לאכול זיתיהן ע׳ ע״י עילה</he> (strike out <cite ref="A01770"><he>אלא</he></cite>) it is customary for people for some cause to use their packed olives for eating.—V. <cite ref="P00445"><he>עֲטִינִים</he></cite>.
